# asitop

> Apple Silicon performance monitoring CLI — fork with Apple M5 Max/Pro/Ultra support

## What it does
- Real-time terminal dashboard for Apple Silicon GPU, CPU, ANE, memory, and power
- Reads hardware performance counters via macOS powermetrics (requires sudo)
- Shows per-cluster CPU frequency and utilization, GPU usage, power draw, thermal throttle status
- Fixed for Apple M5's unified M-cluster architecture (upstream crashes with KeyError on M5)

## Install
```
pip install git+https://github.com/ProducerGuy/asitop.git
```
